Choosing the right photographer for our wedding was one of the most important decisions we had to make, and we are so grateful that we went with Iconic clicks photography.From the very first meeting, they understood our vision and made us feel comfortable, ensuring that every special moment would be captured beautifully.
From the engagement shoot to the wedding day, their professionalism and dedication were truly remarkable. Every smile, every tear, every laughter-filled moment was documented so beautifully that when we look back at our wedding album, it feels like we are reliving our special day all over again.
The quality of the photos exceeded our expectations. The colors were vibrant, the compositions were stunning, and every little detail was enhanced to perfection. Beyond being a talented photographer. Their calm and friendly demeanor made us feel at ease in front of the camera. They coordinated with our family and friends effortlessly, ensuring that group photos were taken efficiently without any stress.
We were also impressed with how quickly they delivered the photos and videos. The entire process, from shooting to editing to delivery, was seamless. They were responsive to our requests and made sure we were completely satisfied with the final results.

If you are looking for a wedding photographer who truly understands how to capture emotions, create stunning visuals, and deliver top-notch service, look no further than Iconic clicks photography. featured_reviews.name: Atisha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired this photographer for two preschool events with a fixed rate agreed for both events.
On the morning of the first event, he suddenly demanded ₹500 extra for just 15 additional minutes, which was never discussed during finalization.
The quality of work was extremely poor:
Main events were missed, while irrelevant side moments were covered
Videos were blurry
No noise cancellation during speeches and parent testimonials
Overall output was unusable and disappointing
When we shared our feedback, he initially accepted his mistake. We requested to meet before the second event to clearly guide him on what needed coverage. After this, he stopped answering calls and messages.
As the second event date approached, he:
Increased the price to double the committed amount
Refused to meet or discuss
Claimed he was traveling
Asked for advance payment
Said he would only talk 2 days before the event
To cover up his poor work, he started blaming us for mismanagement, which was completely untrue.
Additional concerns:
Very poor song selection in videos
If changes are requested, he claims he is “too busy” to discuss
No studio address provided; asked us to meet on a roadside while taking advance
Claimed to bring an extra photographer, but that person was clearly inexperienced and delivered badly zoomed, awkward photos that looked like low-quality BTS shots
Overall, this was a highly unprofessional and dishonest experience.
Not recommended at all, especially for important events involving children and parents.
